title: THE LANDING: the arrival's auto-lander fails, the player flies the SH02 down from the seeded entry, and the grade decides the foundry's salvage and Isao's talk
context: Owner, 2026-11-07: a manual override in the arrival, after his own 2D lander (throttle set not held, the tilt, the legs, a fuel clock, the 2D game's grades), with the touchdown's quality paid in what the foundry can cut; the first start on a browser flies it, later starts offer it. Branch landing-game from 2ca0c418 (overnight-2026-10-23 before the base-from-scratch merge), worked as ten subagent tasks with a review after each (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-07-landing-mini-game-design.md, plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-07-landing-mini-game.md, ledger .superpowers/sdd/progress.md). Every number in src/content/landing-game.js is a starting value with its reason; the owner has not flown it.
outcome:
BUILT: src/content/landing-game.js (the tune), src/domain/manual-landing.js (a fixed 120 Hz model: g 3.2, thrust 12 = T/W 3.75, the set point spooling at 4/s with a 0.2 floor while lit, torque and damping, the legs' drag, the fuel clock; the predictor, hStop, the verdict naming its reason, the flare; pure, the tune a required argument), src/fx/manual-landing.js (the host: the rocket's pose and plumes, the chase looking at the predicted impact, the reticle, the keys, the sounds), src/fx/landing-hud.js (the panel and the touch rail), src/fx/landing-glare.js (the MIT launch shader over the page for the alarm beat), src/fx/arrival.js (OVERRIDE, MANUAL and FLARE cut into the arrival's clock; the touchdown where it touched; the grade to the beats' salvage and the talk), src/fx/start-gate.js (FLY THE LANDING [SPACE] beside START on a later start), src/platform/story-world.js decideLanding (?landing=1|0|offer, td.landing.flown), Isao's override and graded lines, the story lab's ?manual=1, the harness's landing('input'|'skip'|'override') and state().arrival.landing.
AS BUILT: the approach 900 m over 10 s, the override at 3.5 s (the sequence at ~380 m), 3 s of OVERRIDE under a 2.4 s glare, then MANUAL from the entry seeded per planet (300-400 m, sink 30-40, drift 8-12, tilt 0.25-0.35 rad, fuel 18-22 s; on the acceptance seed 349.3 m, sink 30.6, drift 10.25, tilt 0.328, fuel 19.5). The corridor: under 30 m with sink <= 8, drift <= 5, tilt <= 0.25 the auto-lander flares to sink 1.8. Verdict: CLEAN sink 2.5 / drift 1.5 / tilt 4 deg, HARD 6 / 4 / 11 deg, off the pad (14 m) or a 9 deg slope a WRECK. Salvage: CLEAN 3 sections, 60 kg a barrel, 1 bonus barrel; HARD 3, 60, 0; WRECK 2, 48, 0. Talk: arrival_talk_clean, arrival_talk (HARD and every skip), arrival_talk_wreck (four lines).
MEASURED, browser --landing on the acceptance seed (headless 1440 x 900): the scripted pilot (legs down, the tilt toward a drift that returns to the pad, a half burn while the drift is off by 1.5 m/s, the full burn at the stopping distance + 30 m) CLEAN through FLARE, sink 1.8, drift 0, local tilt 0.004, landed [0, 0, -3.3], fuel 12 s left, 'Textbook landing!', the swap, 3 sections; no input WRECK off-pad, sink 36.4, drift 8.5, tilt 0.202 local, landed [0, -6.1, 95.5], 2 sections, the wreck's fourth caption; landing('skip') at 196.6 m CLEAN skipped, landed null, the plain talk, 3 sections; ?gate=1&landing=offer: the gate shows FLY THE LANDING, landing('override') before START makes START fly (the chase shot), START alone lands itself with no panel. In node (scratch sim over 12 seeds) the same pilot is CLEAN on all 12 (fuel left 10.3-16 s, 28-39 s flights) and no input a WRECK off-pad on all 12 (62-102 m out).
THE THREE REVIEW ROUNDS OF THE INTEGRATION (Task 7): 1) the plan's approach could not be flown (the sequence's eased descent handed over 144 m sinking 102 m/s, hStop ~590 m: every flight a wreck): the flight is seeded from the entry under the glare; the offer moved from a SPACE window in the approach (too late: the short arrival touches down at 2.6 s) to the START gate, with ?landing=offer for the suite; the chase looks at the predicted impact so the rocket and the ground share the frame. 2) the touchdown sequence resumed on the pad's centre while a far wreck stood 95 m out (the rail showed an empty pad): from the contact to the cut the holder, the rail, Isao's rise, the scorch and the dust move to where it touched. 3) the review's seven findings: a key held through the contact skipped the door and the rise (the resumed rail locked 1.5 s, then Esc alone; an auto-repeated key never skips any shot), literals into LANDING_GAME.touchdown and .reticle, the WebGL2 glare never built on a coarse pointer, the ground off the pad follows the sphere (the drop and the normal for the pose, the reticle, the slope and the local tilt; the brief's normal had the bowl's sign), FLARE eats the flight keys, Esc's skip puts the rail back in the same frame (no frame without a shot), landed rounded to 0.1.
DEVIATIONS FROM THE SPEC: the no-burn wreck reads off-pad, not sink (the verdict ranks off-pad first and the entry's drift carries an unflown rocket 60-100 m out); the suite asserts either. The extra barrel is not asserted in the browser (the beats grant it at deploy with no counter in state()); test/ covers salvage() and the grades' configurations.
SUITES: on the branch through the lock, --landing exit 0 in 137 s (PASS landing-verdict, landing-wreck, landing-manual, landing-skip, landing-offer-taken, landing-offer-left), --story-world exit 0 (PASS 31; it runs without ?landing=1 and lands automatically), --base-look 0, --skip-tutorial 0, the default suite 0 (PASS 46), npm run check green (td-tab 5,340 / 5,450, untouched by the suite); --grow 1 at 'Isao said gunship_overhead' and --antenna-print 1 at 'the near plane lowered', the base's known reds with the same messages.
OPEN, the owner's calls (the final review's Minor lists): a phone cannot skip the resumed rail; the panel's TILT is the raw tilt while the grade reads the local one; the rocket's lean pops upright at a tilted contact; ALT reads the pad's plane, not the height over the ground off the pad; CAN STOP IN reads red 0 after a clean touchdown; the rocket is small in the chase at 350 m; with &cuts=dive a held key no longer ends the breach cut; the tune itself is unflown by a human.
alternatives: Hand over from the sequence's own state at the override: measured unflyable (144 m at 102 m/s, a 590 m stopping distance); a tune slow enough to fly would have made the automatic arrival a crawl.
The offer as a SPACE window inside the approach: the short arrival touches down at 2.6 s and a late Space seeded altitude 0; the gate's second button is a choice made before anything moves.
Snap a far wreck back to the pad for the touchdown sequence: it would hide what the player did; the rocket stands where it touched and the cut puts the salvage layout back on the pad.
Assert the spec's `sink` for the no-burn wreck by drift-correcting that timeline: that tests a pilot, not 'never burns'; the suite asserts the reason the verdict gives (off-pad on this seed) or sink.
evidence: scripts/browser-test.mjs --landing; stills artifacts/browser/landing-manual.png (the rocket small in the upper half at 196.6 m, the red reticle ring on the island among the domes, the planet's disk filling the lower two thirds, the panel MANUAL ALT 195), landing-verdict.png (the SH02 on the pad beside a dome, LANDING · CLEAN · SINK 1.8), landing-wreck.png (the SH02 leaning between two domes 95 m out, LANDING · WRECK · OFF-PAD, TILT 18.8 on the panel).
The Task 7 report and its three Fix sections (.superpowers/sdd/task-7-report.md) and the Task 10 report (.superpowers/sdd/task-10-report.md); the ledger .superpowers/sdd/progress.md.
